name: Arauzo de Miel (Spain)
description: Square white flag with three wavy horizontal stripes of red, green and yellow from the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arauzo de Miel (a tower, a cross of Saint James, a tree and a beehive).
history: Municipal flag of Arauzo de Miel; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Arauzo de Miel arms — tower, cross of Saint James, tree and beehive
